model: Each microscopic domain has Gaussian diffusion with this same intrinsic tensor,and domain orientations are uniform and independent in space. The normalized powder signal at fixed bis S(b)=integral_0^1 exp(-b*(D_perp+(D_parallel-D_perp)*u^2))du. Here uis the cosine to the symmetry axis and uniform on[0,1]. Use E[u^2]=1/3,E[u^4]=1/5. The small-bfirst cumulant Dbar=E[D(u)]and diffusion-kurtosis convention K=3*Var(D(u))/Dbar^2follow logS=-b*Dbar+(K/6)*(b*Dbar)^2+O(b^3). No intradomain non-Gaussian motion is included.
target: Return Dbarin um^2/ms,the directional-Dvariance in(um^2/ms)^2,the apparent powder diffusion kurtosis K,and S(1). Compare S(1)with exp(-Dbar)from a single isotropic tensor with the same mean,and report whether nonzero powder kurtosis proves intradomain non-Gaussian diffusion in this model.
